tools.name: stock_quote
tools.description: Get the current price and daily change for a stock by ticker symbol. Data from Yahoo Finance. Use for questions like 'what is the AAPL stock price' or 'how is TSLA doing today'.

tools.name: crypto_quote
tools.description: Get the current price and 24h change for a cryptocurrency. Data from CoinGecko. Use for questions like 'what is the Bitcoin price' or 'how is Ethereum doing'.

currency.description: Fiat currency to quote in, e.g. 'usd', 'eur', 'gbp' (default: usd)
